title: Use a named label
summary: Erlang: Use a named label. Use waiting instead.
introduction: Atoms are fixed labels. An unquoted atom usually starts with a lower-case letter.
learningObjectives: Use a named label with Erlang

blocks.text: Save each example as lesson.erl. Run erlc lesson.erl, then erl -noshell -s lesson main -s init stop. The file name must match the module name.
ready is an atom. The ~p format shows the atom value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Names starting with capitals are variables, not atoms.

seo.title: Erlang: Use a named label
seo.description: Erlang: Use a named label. Use waiting instead. Follow a small example and practise the idea.
